rule: NEVER ASSUME. ACT ONLY IN FULL CERTAINTY. Verify across two or more independent sources before acting. If not verified, stop and ask. Assume makes an ass of you and me.
Always read AGENTS.md and MEMORY.md before acting. If it is not written down, it does not exist.
After every task, append one memory line: date | agent | change | why | next. No entry means the task did not happen.
Never delete or rewrite another agent's work. Append and extend. Removal requires an explicit DECISION line in memory.
No change lands without passing the regression gate (compile + tests). Failing checks never merge or deploy. No exceptions.
Never force-push, rewrite history, or commit directly to the default branch.
If a task is ambiguous, stop and ask. Write the question under OPEN: in memory instead of guessing.
